Subject: POC Trial — Model Selection & Success Criteria

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single doc to work from.

Recap (from call)
- Goal: evaluate Redwood inference for customer support assistant (multilingual: EN + ES) across product/subscription questions.
- Key constraints: low-latency responses for chat, cost-conscious at scale, must preserve PII handling and audit logs.

Proposed high-level success criteria (please confirm):
1) Quality: average human rating >= 4/5 on a 200-example blind eval (mix English/Spanish, 70/30).
2) Intent accuracy: >90% for classification tasks derived from the sample dataset.
3) Latency: p50 < 300ms, p95 < 800ms for typical 128-token responses.
4) Cost: target <$X per 1k tokens (we'll refine once we pick model/config).
5) Reliability: end-to-end POC demo without fallbacks failing (session continuity, KV cache).

Model options for the POC (recommendations):
- Primary (quality, multilingual): Llama-2-13b-chat (quantized 4-bit) — best balance for Spanish and detailed answers.
- Cost-optimized variant: Mistral-Instruct-7B — lower token cost and good instruction-following for English, decent Spanish via fine-tuning or prompting.
- Fallback: Falcon-7B or Llama-2-7b (quantized) for constrained/cheap mode; Redwood runtime will auto-fallback on capacity/latency.

Evaluation plan / timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize success criteria + dataset owners (you said Priya would own eval).
- Week 1: SE (Marissa) + Solutions (Aditya) provision endpoints, upload sample dataset (you to share).
- Week 2: Run automated evals, manual human ratings, and latency/cost profiling.
- Week 3: Review results, refine prompts/config, and decide go/no-go or next steps (Dedicated vs Hosted).

Ownership (proposed):
- Sales (Ben): commercial coordination + procurement handoff.
- SE (Marissa): POC technical lead, evaluation leads, and reporting.
- Solutions (Aditya): infra setup, model variant config, quantization advice.
- Customer: Priya (product) as evaluation owner; procurement for purchasing.

Next steps: please confirm the success criteria above and share a sample of the dataset (anonymized) and a preferred time for a kickoff call next week.

Attachments: sample_dataset.csv (you can attach the redacted sample)

Thanks,

Hi Alex / Ben — looping in technical details and a concrete POC plan. Apologies for the long email, wanted to be explicit so we can move quickly.

Technical POC plan (SE perspective)
1) Dataset & eval
   - We prefer a CSV with columns: conversation_id, user_message, expected_intent (optional), expected_answer (optional), language_tag.
   - We'll provide an eval script (python) that: tokenizes, calls model endpoints, captures generation, computes intent accuracy and stores outputs for human rating. I'll attach the rubric.

2) Model selection & config
   - Primary: Llama-2-13b-chat (4-bit quant). Config: max_new_tokens=256, temp=0.2, top_p=0.95. KV cache enabled for session continuity.
   - Cost variant: Mistral-Instruct-7B (same prompt template).
   - Fallback logic: route to Mistral if primary latency > 700ms or if concurrency spikes (we'll define thresholds).

3) Multilingual note
   - Llama-2-13b-chat has stronger out-of-the-box Spanish fluency; for Mistral we recommend a short supervised prompt or a small in-context example set to boost ES responses.

4) Perf testing
   - Baseline: p50/p95 latency tests at 1–10 RPS, and a stress test at expected peak traffic (TBD).

5) Metrics & success mapping
   - Automated: intent accuracy (NLP metric), response coverage (exact/partial match).
   - Human: 5-point relevance/accuracy rating on a 200-sample blind set (70 EN / 30 ES).

Proposed timeline (detail)
- Mon (Week 0 + 1): Kickoff + dataset upload (Customer: Priya).
- Wed (Week 1): Endpoints provisioned (Aditya).
- Thu–Fri (Week 1): Run automated evals and surface initial results.
- Week 2: Human ratings + refine prompts/config.
- Week 3: Final review + decision.

Deliverables we will send: POC playbook (spreadsheet), eval scripts, SOW template.

Attachments: GlobalRetail_POC_plan.xlsx (POC playbook), eval_rubric.md

Ben — I'll take the SE lead. Aditya, can you confirm infra timings (endpoints + region) so I can book the tests?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
